dataset: Global STI Trends Dashboard cleaned dataset

fields.disease: STI disease group: HIV, Gonorrhea, or Syphilis.
fields.disease_type: Disease category such as viral or bacterial.
fields.metric: Indicator/metric name used for raw-value comparisons.
fields.country_code: ISO alpha-3 country code where available.
fields.country_alpha2: ISO alpha-2 country code where available.
fields.value_low: Cleaned lower confidence interval value if available.
fields.value_high: Cleaned upper confidence interval value if available.
fields.ci_width: Cleaned confidence interval width if available.
fields.burden_tier: Standardized burden category: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, VERY HIGH, or UNKNOWN.
fields.value_prev_year: Previous-year value for the same series if available.
fields.yoy_direction: Original direction label for year-over-year change.
fields.normalized_score: Derived value divided by max value within each disease + metric group, capped from 0 to 1.
fields.burden_tier_score: Derived numeric tier score: LOW=1, MEDIUM=2, HIGH=3, VERY HIGH=4, UNKNOWN=null.

comparison_rules: Use raw value only when a specific compatible metric is selected.
Use normalized_score for Disease=All, disease share, and dominant disease comparisons.
Do not silently compare incompatible raw metrics across diseases.
